content: A small spark left unheeded in the dry moss can burn down a great hall.
author: Celtic & Norse Proverbs
sourceWork: Eldr er beztr með ýta sonum (Hávamál & Saga Lore)
explanation: The greatest cataclysms rarely start with towering infernos; they begin with a tiny, smoldering ember dropped onto dry thatch and ignored out of laziness. A tiny seed of resentment, an uncorrected lie, or a minor debt will consume your peace if not extinguished early.
practicalInsight: Extinguish a small smoldering conflict or misunderstanding today before it ignites into a raging feud.
reflectionPrompt: What 'small spark' of resentment or deception are you tolerating that threatens to burn down your peace?
